goal: Expose reached native player diagnostic sites to existing child stderr, preserving the original log path; no system liblog replacement.
feasibility: Conditional small candidate, not statically ruled out. A compat-only unique export is insufficient: the exact player import must explicitly bind it.

source_build.reuse: Existing compat source and dockbuild OH clang15 recipe; retain existing OpenSL identifiers/constructor unchanged in a new sibling. New wrapper export must be independently named; no global __android_log_print interposition.
source_build.inputs: Pin current9f compat source/toolchain recipe and current5f player. New source/build raw stdout+stderr+rc and deterministic player import-derivation receipts would be required; not built here.
source_build.warning: Original build script copies pinned selected-change source before compilation. A successor must explicitly select the new source; editing a discarded temporary src copy is ineffective.

binding.required: A deterministic exact-player-only import binding to the new unique symbol in the inherited compat instance; adding an exported function or preloading a same-name log symbol is not sufficient.
binding.proof: Inspect the derived player symbol/relocation/version scope and actual resulting GOT plus compat ELF/SHA/inode; preserve the existing105 OBJECT self-relative relocations.
binding.forwarding: Mirror bounded diagnostic data to existing fd2 while forwarding original varargs/priority/tag and preserving return/errno to the previously identified original liblog entry. vprint is a possible forwarding interface only after exact ABI/behavior/instance verification; RTLD_DEFAULT/RTLD_NEXT guesses do not establish the intended provider. Do not call the new wrapper recursively.
binding.namespace: Existing run exports compat preload+inherit, but actual binding must still be observed for this player instance. Maps alone do not suffice.

coverage.possible: Native __android_log_print sites actually reached by this exact player, including the independently identified INFO ttmn load marker; mirror before liblog filtering can expose lower priorities if their producer executes.
not_guaranteed: central logger FILE* or SDK callback-only routes bypassing the imported print
logs emitted by other DSOs or another player instance

minimal_observation: Use a unique marker for caller-relative PC/priority/tag and bounded non-content status; retain full payload only in private raw evidence when needed. Avoid exposing video URLs/user content publicly. A marker proves that boundary was reached, not that prepare completed.

impact_and_rollback.scope: New compat artifact plus exact player derivation; existing run/media/cfg unchanged if preload/inherit names remain. Compat is process-visible but unique function has no effect without the selected consumer.
impact_and_rollback.effects: Added fd2 writes can change timing or block; bound message size and volume, preserve original call and errors. No broad logging threshold/sink reset.
impact_and_rollback.rollback: Reuse existing four-file transaction with newly approved exact after-pins and original backups, full CAS/metadata/inode guards and fresh parent/child via existing reboot route; do not mutate an active GOT or running inode. Baseline original tuple remains the exit path.

decision: Do the already proposed concentrated read once if needed; do not indefinitely chase hilog internals. Candidate implementation should be a separate narrow source/ELF derivation after this feasibility review, not part of r7 evidence or a playback fix.
